sources.title: Overalls README
sources.finding: Self-hosted platform for persistent Firecracker development machines (NixOS, Ubuntu, Windows) and the AI agents on them; built-in agent plus Codex and Claude Code pre-installed; browser, SSH, VS Code, overalls CLI and Mila app; research preview launching 12 November 2026; no hosted version; MIT.

sources.title: Porsche getting started
sources.locator: Register your key; Connect; Install the Overalls CLI; First commands
sources.finding: Email login, SSH key registration, Porsche SSH management commands new/ls/show/start/stop/relocate/pin, per-machine installer for Linux, macOS and Windows, 500 GiB disk cap.

sources.title: Automation
sources.finding: JSON output, request IDs for idempotent retries, wait timeouts of 120 seconds with --no-wait.

sources.title: Public documentation index
sources.finding: Browser extension, SSH guides, automation, reflection, notifications; llms.txt for language-model clients; Porsche provides no guest shell, file transfer or port forwarding.

sources.title: Push notifications
sources.finding: Content-free end-to-end encrypted push to Mila devices via the Susan relay for agent questions and plan proposals.

sources.title: Architecture overview
sources.finding: ADR-driven record: guest coding CLIs, memory-preserving suspension and demand wake, native Mila clients, with many ADRs marked accepted/partial; execution evidence and acceptance tracked separately.

sources.title: Ziggy private inference
sources.finding: Guests reach models only through Ziggy at llm.internal; Codex and Claude Code use native config with no OpenAI login or provider key in the guest; OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages supported; Marshall admission per request.

sources.title: Underclass
sources.finding: Operator-added Codex and Copilot accounts pooled behind a proxy with proxy-only credentials; quota and overload handling.

sources.title: Ubuntu guests
sources.finding: Ubuntu images install pinned Codex 0.149.0 and Claude Code 2.1.238 configured for Ziggy.

sources.title: Guest OS matrix
sources.finding: Seven OS families (NixOS, Ubuntu 26.04, Arch, Alma, FreeBSD 14.3, OmniOS, Windows Server 2025) each with recorded lifecycle evidence of differing scope.

sources.title: Thread modes
sources.finding: User-facing agent modes low, medium, high, ultra mapping to configured model and reasoning effort; default medium.

sources.title: Agent tool protocol
sources.finding: Built-in agent tools include spawn_child_agent ("start an independent child agent in this machine and wait for its result"), web_search and file reads.

sources.title: Planning turns
sources.finding: Planning turns with child agents returning findings, unresolved decisions and recommendations.

sources.title: Plan proposals
sources.finding: A completed planning response with a single implementation admission (human-approved plan).

sources.title: Planning questions
sources.finding: Durable human-answer barrier belonging to a root planning turn.

sources.title: CLI access
sources.finding: Browser-approved, short-lived (one hour) access for the user's overalls CLI; secret never visible to the browser.

sources.title: Agents domain
sources.finding: Durable VM-bound agent threads, turns, executor leases and audit receipts with paper-trail versions.

sources.title: Threads domain
sources.finding: User-facing conversations that own an automatically provisioned machine.

sources.title: Thread grants
sources.finding: Thread membership roles viewer, operator and manager retained with granting actor history.

sources.title: Teams domain
sources.finding: Shared machines and resources across accounts with owner/admin/member roles; SCIM-managed teams.

sources.title: SCIM OIDC sign-in
sources.finding: OIDC authorization-code sign-in for SCIM-provisioned identities with PKCE and ID-token verification; no automatic registration.

sources.title: Machine sharing
sources.finding: Transactional sharing, protected ownership and idempotent role replacement over Cedar policy.

sources.title: Artifacts domain
sources.finding: Agent-published, versioned pages shared through Cedar roles with immutable versions.

sources.title: Message boards
sources.finding: User and profile message boards with machine-scoped cleanup usable by agents and people.

sources.title: GitHub integration
sources.finding: Per-user GitHub OAuth custody with fenced admission; credentials injected at the edge and never in guests.

sources.title: Integrations page
sources.finding: UI text: connect GitHub for Git, pull requests, Actions and releases; credentials stay at the edge.

sources.title: Inference usage export
sources.finding: Owner usage CSV with request_id, vm_id, owner_id, provider, model, tokens and estimated_token_usd with pricing source/version.

sources.title: Capacity budget
sources.finding: Physical headroom less outstanding startup and relocation holds; missing usage withholds admission.

sources.title: Notifications domain
sources.finding: Content-free push for Mila devices produced after agent question and plan proposal commits; end-to-end encrypted pokes to Susan.

sources.title: Editor domain
sources.finding: Browser editor authority (VS Code) independent from ordinary web endpoint policy.

sources.title: Terminal domain
sources.finding: Durable terminal session registry with audit events for browser console access.

sources.title: Lilly provisioner
sources.finding: Lilly manages Firecracker microVMs, ZFS storage and guest networks on each execution host; running guests survive Lilly restarts.

sources.title: Lyra and overalls CLI
sources.finding: Rust package behind the overalls CLI configuring developer SSH access through Audi and submitting browser-approved agent prompts; also the in-guest tool executor.

sources.title: Mila clients
sources.finding: Native clients for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux as thin wrappers over a shared Rust core; Buck2 builds; release acceptance partial; no published releases.

sources.title: Porsche SSH gateway
sources.finding: Elixir SSH management gateway turning commands into authenticated Marshall API calls.

sources.title: SCIM domain
sources.finding: SCIM configuration and provisioning boundary with team retirement workers.

sources.title: Security policy
sources.finding: Private GitHub advisory or email with PGP key; no hosted service.

sources.title: MIT licence
sources.finding: MIT licence.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 1664 stars, MIT, homepage overalls.dev, description "[experimental] An AI-first developer platform that you own. Overalls launches on 12 November 2026."; no GitHub releases.

sources.title: overalls.dev self-host guide
sources.finding: Official site pages: self-hosting guide (provision, deploy, DNS, enroll, first machine, operations) and architecture; no screenshots of the product UI.

sources.title: Bounded search: agent harnesses
sources.locator: grep for gemini, aider, cursor-agent, opencode, antigravity, grok across marshall/lib, lyra, ziggy, docs/services, docs/guests
sources.finding: Only the built-in agent, Codex and Claude Code appear as supported guest harnesses; no adapter for other CLIs.

sources.title: Bounded search: issue tracker
sources.locator: grep for issue, ticket, backlog, kanban, linear, jira across marshall/lib and lyra
sources.finding: No native issue/ticket entity or external tracker import; threads are conversations.

sources.title: Bounded search: unattended triggers
sources.locator: grep for cron, recurring, scheduled prompt, webhook across marshall/lib/marshall/agents, threads, docs
sources.finding: No user-facing schedule, recurring agent run or inbound webhook; scheduling terms are internal Oban jobs and host maintenance.

sources.title: Bounded search: pull request, merge, deploy
sources.locator: grep for create_pull_request, merge, deploy across marshall/lib/marshall/agents and lyra
sources.finding: No product PR creation, merge or deploy workflow; GitHub is reached from guests via edge-injected credentials.

sources.title: Bounded search: review UI
sources.locator: grep for diff, unified diff, review comment across marshall/lib/marshall_web/live
sources.finding: No code-diff or review view in the web interface; changes are viewed in the guest editor or terminal.

sources.title: Bounded search: spend limits and billing
sources.locator: grep for billing, invoice, spend limit, price plan across marshall/lib, docs/services, docs/operations
sources.finding: No billing or spend cap; inference usage is recorded with estimates and CSV export only.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry
sources.locator: grep for posthog, sentry, analytics, mixpanel across marshall/lib, lyra, mila
sources.finding: No product analytics; Phoenix telemetry is internal metrics and independent observability for operators; the overalls.dev site loads a first-party analytics script.

sources.title: Bounded search: MCP and webhooks
sources.locator: grep for model context protocol, mcp server, webhook across marshall/lib, lyra, ziggy
sources.finding: No MCP server or webhook; one MCP mention is incidental.

sources.title: Bounded search: vendor-hosted service
sources.locator: grep for hosted version, saas, sign up, subscription, paid plan across README, docs, marshall/lib
sources.finding: README states there is no hosted version; the only vendor-run services are the optional Susan push relay and docs/newsletter endpoints.
